title: AI Analyst: Framework and Comprehensive Evaluation of Large Language Models for Financial Time Series Report Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing automated evaluation scores (using GPT-4o as the G-Eval evaluator) with human expert annotations to detect potential systematic favoritism towards text generated by the same model family.

Qualitative observation and error analysis during the human evaluation of generated financial reports, identifying a tendency for models to favor reporting positive or above-average market trends while avoiding low points.
